content:
Ellen (AE): Need fast approval — partner 'BlueArc' requests 9.5% reseller margin and 16% customer discount for a 12-month $200k ARR commit. They also asked for a $10k MDF and a one-time onboarding rebate. Can Deal Desk + Finance review?

Diego (Partner Lead): BlueArc covers government channels in LATAM. Margin critical for them to staff cleared sellers. They promise 4 logos if we approve.

Marta (Deal Desk): Summary: discount 16%, reseller margin 9.5% (exception), MDF $10k, onboarding rebate = refund of 1 month if POC fails. Need Finance impact and Legal on rebate wording. Fallback: 9% margin + 15% discount + $7k MDF.

Ken (Finance): Quick calc: net_year1 = 200k*(1-0.16) - 10k - (200k*0.095) = 168k - 10k - 19k = 139k. Need to check CAC and partner payback. If partner pipeline evidence shows >2x ARR in 12 months, finance can provisionally OK as one-off with reporting. Also prefer margin paid on net after discounts.

legal-bot: Flag: onboarding rebate needs SLA & cap. MDF usage controls required. No white-labeling. Please attach contract draft for redlines.

Diego (Partner Lead): Partner insists margin must be on gross; they said net introduces too much variability to their ops.

Marta (Deal Desk): Compromise proposal: approve 9.5% margin but pay on net, $8k MDF (reduced), onboarding rebate capped at 1 month and conditional on specific POC criteria. Require quarterly reconciliations and 12-month clawback window. Routing to Finance + Legal + CRO.

Ellen (AE): Opp link: https://crm.redwood.ai/opps/RED-4872. Need decision by EOD tomorrow to secure partner. Happy to paste POC success criteria into thread.

Ken (Finance): I'll review pipeline and modeling. If pipeline checks out, we'll accept the compromise as a one-time exception; will require reporting dashboard and MDF receipts.

Marta (Deal Desk): Marking priority high and kicking approvals. Will post redlines once Legal responds.

legal-bot: Request received. Estimated review 36-48h.
